question: Seven boxes of different colours, Red, Yellow, Blue, Green, Orange, Violet and Indigo were stocked one on the other, not necessarily in the same order. No other box was placed below the orange box. The Violet box was placed second to the top of the Blue box. The Green box was second to the bottom of the Indigo box. The Red box was placed at the topmost position. The Yellow box was exactly above the Indigo box. Which of the following is the correct pair of box and its position?

options.text: Violet box – 7th position from the top
Yellow box – 5th position from the top
Green box – 3rd position from the top
Blue box – 6th position from the top
